$schema_note: Design Reference Atlas — machine-readable. Evidence tiers: LIVE (rendered+inspected this project), SEARCH (cited live web search), CODE (verified against public repo/design-system docs), PROVENANCE (verified designer/studio attribution), RECALLED (training knowledge, lowest tier, always flagged). See PROFESSIONAL_WEB_DESIGN_RESEARCH.md Part 1 for full method.

provenance.evidence: Design Museum's Design of the Year award; public GitHub repo; on-page 'Support' section credits 'a team at the Government Digital Service'

entries.primary_visual_approach: Plain document structure; restraint instrumented to a stated purpose (user need over government convenience), not generic minimalism
entries.composition: Single-column, linear, heading+paragraph+link blocks repeated ~10x — genre-appropriate for a documentation portal
entries.color: one blue, one green, high-contrast black-on-white, crest mark
entries.product_specific_structures: flat 0-radius button with hard 2px offset shadow (not soft box-shadow) — a real, consistent brand signature
entries.responsive_behavior: verified clean reflow at 3 widths, LIVE
entries.authorship_signals: dated, specific release notes (v6.4.0, named component changes); restrained content (no padding)
entries.weaknesses: genre is intrinsically plain (documentation portal) — some plainness may not transfer as evidence to marketing-page contexts
entries.transferable_principles: restraint instrumented to a stated, verifiable purpose reads as authored; a hard-offset non-blurred shadow is a legitimate, distinctive alternative to the generic soft-shadow default
entries.do_not_copy: the specific crest mark and GDS Transport typeface (protected government identity)

provenance.designers_or_studio: GitHub Primer core team (named 'About us' page)
provenance.evidence: public repo github.com/primer, on-page team credit page

entries.primary_visual_approach: Large centered wordmark hero, hand-drawn wireframe illustrations as literal component demos
entries.composition: 3 large hero cards, then 3-up and 2-up rows
entries.density: low, shortest page in the round-7 corpus (2147px scroll height)
entries.imagery: hand-drawn wireframe-style illustrations, real Octocat SVG variations
entries.product_specific_structures: component demos are literal (a real toast, a real spacing-measurement diagram), not decorative
entries.responsive_behavior: verified clean reflow at 3 widths, LIVE
entries.authorship_signals: organized around Primer's actual 2 real audiences (product engineers, brand designers); real production overflow bug found live ('Display' clipped to 'Displo' at 1440px) — logged as evidence bugs occur on both AI and human work, not a provenance signal
entries.weaknesses: one lorem-ipsum placeholder string inside a simulated UI mockup (inside a component demo, not real site copy — different case from shipped placeholder content)
entries.transferable_principles: restraint (short page relative to how much the system actually documents); literal, specific component demonstrations beat decorative illustration

entries.primary_visual_approach: Huge (107px) tight orange-on-navy H1 over full-bleed duotone satellite/terrain photograph with dotted grid overlay

typography.letter_spacing_h1: -0.03em (-3.22358px at 107.453px) — edge of the previously-flagged AI-tell range

entries.composition: mark/nav, headline+subhead, three vertical links (Government/Biopharma/Microgravity Research), dated announcement bar
entries.density: low at hero, increasing further down
entries.color: navy/orange duotone applied to real photography
entries.product_specific_structures: three nav verticals match Varda's actual 3 real business lines, not generic Solutions/Products/Company
entries.responsive_behavior: not fully re-verified at all breakpoints this round
entries.authorship_signals: tagline 'Space born, Earth bound' fails the Product Swap Test in the POSITIVE direction — only makes sense for Varda's actual round-trip microgravity-manufacturing model
entries.weaknesses: internal pages not inspected; cross-route coherence untested
entries.transferable_principles: MOST IMPORTANT: dotted grid overlay on a REAL satellite photograph is direct counter-instance evidence that 'technical framing decoration' is not automatically a hollow AI tell — it reads as motivated because it sits on literal geospatial imagery, unlike this project's own earlier Perigee example where a similar device framed a non-photographic illustrative diagram with no representational justification. Also a 4th independent confirmation that negative tracking (-0.03em here) is not diagnostic.

entries.primary_visual_approach: Deliberately flat, no dominant focal point, scan-based reading path, extremely high density
entries.composition: ~15 category blocks, uniform link-list styling, no card treatment anywhere
entries.density: extremely high — dozens of links without scrolling at 1440px
entries.imagery: a single peace-sign logo mark; embedded event calendar widget
entries.product_specific_structures: the page structure IS the product's actual category taxonomy, exposed directly with no abstraction layer
entries.authorship_signals: restraint has an explicit business rationale (high-frequency trust-through-familiarity marketplace) confirmed directly by round-6 SEARCH sourcing, not just inferred
entries.weaknesses: n/a for this record's purpose — logged specifically as the clearest available counterexample
entries.transferable_principles: THE canonical case that 'looks good' and 'works well' are separable axes; near-zero properties in common with any AI-generation convention this project catalogs — not merely 'not generic,' close to orthogonal to the entire evaluative frame
entries.do_not_copy: n/a — this is the opposite of a style to imitate cosmetically; the lesson is the underlying reasoning (density serves the actual task), not the literal visual output
